title: Payments Engineer
summary: Builds the backend systems that move money: UPI, card and net banking payments, payment gateways, settlement and reconciliation. Works in a fintech, bank or card network engineering team, where correctness, security rules such as PCI DSS and high volumes matter more than features.
dailyDuties: Build and change payment APIs and services
Integrate with banks, card networks or the UPI switch
Fix failed or stuck transactions and reversals
Review designs for idempotency, retries and data safety
Support audits and security reviews of payment flows

skills.expectation: Build payment services in Java, Go or Node.js
Build payment services in Java, Go or Node.js
Build payment services in Java, Go or Node.js
Know how UPI, cards, net banking and wallets work end to end
Integrate with banks, networks and the UPI switch using ISO 8583, ISO 20022 or gateway APIs
Build reconciliation and settlement jobs that match transactions with bank and network files
Build and run payment microservices with clear ownership
Design payment APIs with idempotency keys, retries and reversals
Design transaction tables and write safe, consistent SQL
Use Kafka or a similar queue for payment events
Design high-volume payment flows that stay correct under failure
Build within PCI DSS and RBI rules for card data, logs and audit trails
Build Java services with Spring Boot
Use encryption, tokenisation and HSM-backed key management
Use Redis or similar for caching and locks
Track payment success rates with metrics, logs and traces

groups.label: A payments backend language (Java, Go or Node.js)

certifications.why: Shows Java depth for Java-heavy bank and fintech teams
Shows Kafka skill for event-driven payment systems
